assumptions.statement: Submitted site and key-area geometries are provisional constraints derived from the cleared repository package.
assumptions.impact: They support conceptual generation and internal checks only; all geometry-derived metrics and drawings must be regenerated when official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: Regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, heritage constraints, and engineering conditions are not supplied as cleared official attachments.
assumptions.impact: The package makes conceptual spatial recommendations only and does not claim statutory controls, approved demolition, construction scale, or engineering feasibility.

assumptions.statement: Scenario operators, data permissions, funding, and service protocols require public-interest governance and professional agreements.
assumptions.impact: AI scenarios include human review, pause, fallback, and appeal paths rather than autonomous deployment claims.
